exposure: Number of deliveries at a given hospital per year
Length of second stage of labor
outcome: Operative delivery (operative vaginal and cesarean delivery)
Adverse maternal outcomes (composite of postpartum hemorrhage, transfusion, endometritis, third-/fourth-degree laceration)
Adverse neonatal outcomes (composite of neonatal intensive care unit admission, hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, respiratory distress, seizures, apnea, asphyxia, shoulder dystocia)
cohort: The study included 22,299 nulliparous women with singleton, term, vertex gestations who achieved 10 cm cervical dilation with epidural anesthesia.
finding: A risk predictor calculator was created and validated to predict the odds of spontaneous vaginal delivery and adverse maternal/neonatal outcomes based on various factors, including the length of time in the second stage of labor.
mod_finding: The developed calculator helps predict spontaneous vaginal delivery rates and risks of maternal and neonatal morbidity with the increasing length of the second stage of labor, aiding decisions regarding the mode of birth.
